description_en: Changes the mode in which a website service is added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
description_zh: 设置网站业务的接入模式
name: ModifyWebAccessMode

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which a website service is added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium. Valid values:

0: A record mode
1: anti-DDoS mode
2: origin redundancy mode
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的接入模式。取值：
0：A记录
1：高防模式
2：回源模式
